Lesson Plan

3

Grade/Level

Adaptable for secondary, postsecondary, adult learning, and workforce training.

4

Learning Goals

By the end of the lesson, learners will be able to:

  • Define AI literacy.
  • Identify common places where AI appears in daily life.
  • Explain basic AI-related ideas such as data, algorithms, machine learning, generative AI, and uncertainty.
  • Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, bias, privacy, transparency, accountability, and need for human oversight.
  • Describe why AI literacy matters as a civic and workforce skill.
